title: AWS re:Invent 2018: [REPEAT 1] A Serverless Journey: AWS Lambda Under the Hood (SRV409-R1)
summary: An AWS re:Invent 2018 session in which Holly Mesrobian and Marc Brooker explain how AWS Lambda is built, including its sandboxing, isolation and scaling architecture. It covers what happens under the hood when serverless code runs.
why: HN cites it as the authoritative description of Lambda internals and isolation, by the engineers who built it.

quote.text: You can watch this talk to learn more
